title: Present the DPI-H definition as a working definition
requirements:
- Introduce DPI-H as the working definition adopted for this guidance
- Choose one way of describing how DPI-H relates to foundational DPI (extends, complements, builds on) and use it consistently throughout
- Specify the minimum attributes of 'publicly governed'
- Reflect public value across the ecosystem and assisted/non-digital routes
- Invite countries to map national terms to DPI-H concepts
